reports.title: Digital Turbine Reports Strong Fiscal 2027 Second Quarter Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: Based on information available as of November 9, 2026, the Company currently expects the following for fiscal year 2027:
•Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA2 of between $145 million and $155 million

It is not reasonably practicable to provide a business outlook for GAAP net income because the Company cannot reasonably estimate the changes in stock-based compensation expense, which is directly impacted by changes in the Company’s stock price, or other items that are difficult to predict with precision.
